title: HPSM-POC: a feedback retry after a timeout can save a second copy. Build a guard, or accept the risk for now?
bluf: Tap a or b. If the hosted site times out after a feedback item is already saved, the user's retry saves a second copy (HPSMPOC-226 item N-8; B241 STATUS line 33). Every other item on that ticket is built or confirmed (B284 STATUS census, read at source on main befd45e). The fix needs an idempotency key per submission: a contract change, a database migration on both providers, and edits to the API and the web server (B241 STATUS line 33, relayed by B284). How often the timeout happens on the hosted site is unmeasured.

options.label: Accept the risk for now; revisit if duplicates show up
options.detail: Nothing is built. HPSMPOC-226 stays open for N-8 only, with this decision recorded on it.

options.label: Build the guard
options.detail: A seat builds the idempotency key (contract, migration, API, web server), gated like any change. Tuesday briefs it as its own lane after the current HPSM-POC work.

default_action: Option a: nothing is built, the risk is recorded on HPSMPOC-226, and Tuesday re-raises it only if a duplicate is ever seen.
_override_prior: matches share only the word feedback (button place, pill colour, routing to Jira, report exposure, loop mechanism); none rules on a duplicate item from a retry or an idempotency key
